svg.title: Three deployment modes
svg.desc: Compares local single-process, distributed multi-process, and containerized Docker deployment modes

g.text: Recommended for your platform now: Mode B (distributed)
Python process per artifact, launched via SSH, managed by systemd, communicating over HTTP

svg.text: Distribution unit = artifact type, not tool count

g.text: each tool runs on its assigned node
One agent + all tools can share a VM
